div.head: Blas 1
div.ab: We cwedon be ðam blaserum 7 be ðam morðslihtum, þæt man dypte ðone að be ðryfealdum 7 myclade þæt ordalisen, ðet hit wǽge ðreo pund, 7 eode se man sylf to, ðe man tuge.
CXXI. We cwædon be þam blaserum ⁊ be þam morþslyhtum, þæt man dypte þone aþ be þryfealdum ⁊ myclade þæt ordalysen, þæt hit gewege þry pund, ⁊ eode se man sylf to, þe man tuge.
Diximus (Dictum est) de blaseriis et murditoribus, ut augeatur iuramentum huius abnegationis tripliciter, et maioretur iudiciale ferrum, ut appendat LX sol., et adeat ipse (homo) compellatus.
We cwædon be þam blaserum and be þam morð-slyhtum, þæt man dypte þone að be þryfealdum and myclade þæt ordalysen, þæt hit gewege þry pund, and eode se man sylf to, þe man tuge,

With regard to incendaries and those who secretly compass death, we have declared that the oath shall be augmented threefold and the weight of the iron used in the ordeal shall be increased until it weighs three pounds.
We declared about incendaries and underhand killings that the oath be deepened threefold and the ordeal-iron enlarged to a weight of three pounds.

Wir [König und Witan] haben über die Brandstifter und über die heimlichen Morde bestimmt, dass ihr [Reinigungs]eid ums dreifache erschwert, beziehungsweise das Ordaleisen grösser genommen werde, so dass es 3 Pfund wiege; und der verklagte Mann trete selbst hinzu [nicht ein Vertreter trage es].

We [the king and witan] have declared concerning arsonists and secret murders that their [clearing] oath be made three times heavier, or the ordeal iron be made larger so that it weighs 3 pounds; and let the accused man go to it himself [no representative to carry it].
div.note: The Quadripartitus's ‘LX sol.’ is Norman (compare Hu 9 and Duns 7). Liebermann compares II As 6–6.2. The Consiliatio Cnuti III 1 has another Latin version.
